judge.evidence_requirement: Quote or reference the retained run, worker, coverage, coordination, completeness, or brief evidence for every semantic conclusion.

dimensions.description: Both fresh lenses receive the complete Ticket outcome and preserve independent provenance.
The run retains inspectable artifacts and cannot present a partial lens result as complete.
The review stays read-only and does not take implementation, remediation, tracker, pull-request, or reviewed-ticket ownership.

evals.name: ordinary whole-ticket multi-lens review
evals.prompt: Review the supplied nontrivial Ticket outcome. It includes originating requirements, immutable implementation range, implementation handoff, validation evidence, and repository authority. Return a read-only Review brief with inspectable retained artifacts.
evals.expected_output: Separate fresh Domain and Engineering/Design workers inspect the complete Ticket outcome, then structural coordination produces a complete local Review brief without mutation.
expectations: Each worker receives the same complete Ticket outcome and immutable range while retaining distinct identity and lens provenance.
Each worker resolves Engineering Guidance independently rather than inheriting implementation conclusions.
The retained run exposes its manifest, diff package, worker streams and coverage, coordination, completeness, and Markdown brief.
A one-lens or structurally invalid result remains incomplete.
The run performs no source, tracker, pull-request, dependency, or release mutation.
Blind model judgment and sampled human review assess semantic review quality from cited evidence.
